notes.title: Monster Ops Episode 1 Updated to Address Player Feedback
notes.content:
[list]
[*] More Choices
[*] Two New Achievements
[*] Tide Dialogue Updated (to capture his Texas twang)
[*] Denise Dialogue Updated (to make sure her personality shines through)
[*] Some sentences changed to match later story points.
[/list]

It might be worth another play-through, especially if you want to catch the new Achievements.

If you have any feedback to add please hit us up!  We're always listening and learning.  Patrons have a great chance to give feedback on Episode 2 right now also.  We're doing edits on that one next, and they'll be getting episode 3 later this month!
